title: The Owner sees every meter, node and line of a flow show its loop state (working, connected, waiting or broken) and can tap any of them to see what it is
description: On 2026-11-11 the Owner asked for motion and glow on every meter of a flow: loops that are all good should look constantly flowing, an active process at full brightness and fast motion, a fully hooked up flow dimmer with slower motion, a node waiting for a cycle still but pulsing, and a broken or incomplete process in warning tones, with any node or connection tappable to say what it is. The web kit gains one look for four loop states (ui-kit/loop.tsx and a Loop states section in flow.css): working is full brightness, fast travelling dashes and a glow; connected is dimmer with slow dashes; waiting is still with a soft pulse; broken is caution tones and no motion. flowLoop() maps the Supervisor's flow state and gate to a loop state (running is working; ready, not_due, wip and machine_busy are connected; no_engine, cap_required, budget, stalled and dial_unapproved are broken; anything else waits). The flow page applies it to the hero ring's five stages and the lines between them, the region path and its hand-offs, the measure dials, the spend gauge, the KPI tiles and the Controls row. Tapping or pressing Enter on any of them opens a small panel with its name, its state, what it is and why; Escape closes it. Reduced motion and calm mode stop the motion and keep colour, brightness and words different. No em dashes.
acceptance: flowLoop maps a running flow to working, a healthy idle flow to connected, a disabled flow to waiting and a gated problem to broken
A running flow lights its first ring stage and line as working while the rest of the loop flows as connected
A broken flow shows every ring line in warning tones
Clicking a node, a line, a gauge or a region hand-off opens a panel that says what it is; Escape closes it
Reduced motion and calm mode keep a still difference instead of motion
